title: 🐶 Playful Hounds and Mixed Breeds Ready for Adoption in Jackson, OH - NewsBreak
text:
11 hours ago Looking for a loyal companion? The Jackson County Dog Pound has several wonderful dogs waiting for their forever homes. These friendly pups come in all shapes and colors, each with a heart full of love to share.
Sequoia Breed: Mixed Breed (Medium)
Age: Adult
Gender: Female
Color: Brown/Chocolate
Sequoia is a beautiful brown girl with a calm, gentle spirit. She’s ready to meet her new family and start a new chapter full of love and care.
Shelter: Jackson County Dog Pound
Phone: (740) 286-7262
👉 Meet Sequoia and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Glacier Breed: Mixed Breed (Medium)
Age: Young
Gender: Female
Color: Gray/Blue/Silver/Salt & Pepper
Glacier’s cool coat and bright eyes make her stand out. She’s young, curious, and eager to learn — a great match for an active home.
Shelter: Jackson County Dog Pound
Phone: (740) 286-7262
👉 Meet Glacier and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Canyon Breed: Mixed Breed (Medium)
Age: Adult
Gender: Male
Color: Gray/Silver/Salt & Pepper with White
Canyon is a handsome boy with a soft gray coat and a friendly face. He’s looking for someone to share long walks and cozy evenings.
Shelter: Jackson County Dog Pound
Phone: (740) 286-7262
👉 Meet Canyon and apply to adopt on adoptapet

If you’re near Jackson, Ohio , stop by the Jackson County Dog Pound or call (740) 286-7262 to learn more about these adoptable dogs. Your new best friend could be waiting for you!
Please note: Pet availability changes quickly. Some pets listed here may have already been adopted or reclaimed, and links may no longer be active. Contact the shelter directly for the most up-to-date information.
